Weekend Recap — May 18, 2026

📅 May 18, 2026 ✍️ Konstantinos Chaldoupis
Premier League | La Liga | Serie A | Bundesliga | Ligue 1

🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 Premier League: Matchday 37

Manchester United secured a commanding victory over Nottingham Forest, taking an early lead through Luke Shaw and maintaining their advantage until halftime. Forest briefly threatened after the break when Morato pulled one back in the 53rd minute, but United responded emphatically. Matheus Cunha swiftly restored the lead for the Red Devils before Bryan Mbeumo added a third in the 76th minute to seal the win. Adding to the celebration, Bruno Fernandes equalled the all-time Premier League assist record for a single season during the match.
